title: A Unified Control Plane for Machine-Learning Security Services
subtitle: An Authenticated Gateway with Configurable ML Security Service Endpoints

cards.label: synchronous service slots in configured topology
local contract topology, not production products

contribution: A real authenticated FastAPI control plane with four production HTTP service slots, a local contract-test topology built from stubs, and a production Compose contract that requires externally released product images instead of pretending the stubs are product implementations.
methods: Authenticate external callers at the gateway.
Strip caller-controlled sensitive headers and inject per-service credentials.
Route four synchronous service prefixes over an internal-only network.
Use local health-contract stubs to test topology without misrepresenting product logic.
Require explicit external product images in production Compose.
Validate unit, security, integration, image-build, and deployment-contract behavior in CI.
evidence: Cited Python 3.12 CI: 82 passed; 95.96% statement coverage, same test job.
Source implements an authenticated gateway and four synchronous service slots. Local Compose exercises contract stubs.
Cited CI includes successful stub health and integration jobs; production product images must be supplied externally.
Image signing, attestation and release steps were skipped in the cited run. No deployed service, uptime or load SLO is established.
limitations: Product business logic is owned by external repositories/images.
No production deployment, uptime, or load SLO is established.
Multi-replica shared rate limiting/state distribution requires deployment-specific infrastructure.
Batch tools such as HF provenance scanning and adversarial robustness are intentionally not forced behind synchronous HTTP routes.
reproduction: Install the documented development dependencies; run python -m pytest tests/ -q. Use the cited job configuration when reproducing coverage.
Benchmark data, adapters and environment requirements are separate; consult poster/13_reproducibility.md and the claim ledger.
